children: Skye Bioscience terminated its Master Services Agreement with Lohman & Associates, effective Sep 8, 2026, following the resignation of CFO John P. Sharp. The termination occurred the same day notice was given and represents an early end to the engagement. No termination fees were disclosed. The company appointed CEO Punit Dhillon as principal financial and accounting officer to oversee finance functions.
